design_change.observed_problem: The one-shot Worker could be successfully re-enabled and retargeted by Broker yet remain undelivered well past DTSTART after it had already fired previously.
design_change.remediation: Use the same Worker automation as an enabled hourly recurring scheduler anchor. Broker precommits the wake generation, then retargets the Worker's next occurrence earlier while preserving RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY. Natural hourly Worker occurrences fast-noop unless an unserved wake or exact partial gateway execution exists.
